body:
## What this tour is

This Tiqets listing (`p1065031`) combines **reserved entry to the Louvre Museum** with a focused **1-hour live guided orientation tour** capped at a **maximum group size of 20 participants**. Operated by **Extime Travel** (194 Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris), the experience is designed for visitors who want direct escorted entry and a structured path to the Louvre's most famous works.

## Itinerary and highlights covered

According to the listing read on 29 October 2026, the 60-minute guided route covers:

- **Leonardo da Vinci's *Mona Lisa* (1506)**
- **Ancient Greek & Roman sculpture:** The *Venus de Milo*, the *Caryatids*, and Etruscan collections
- **Pharaonic Egypt & Near Eastern Antiquities:** The *Seated Scribe*, an Egyptian mummy, and artifacts from Mesopotamia, Syria, and Persia
- **French Crown Jewels & Painting:** The *Galerie d'Apollon*, Delacroix's *Liberty Leading the People*, the Apartments of Napoleon III, and French sculptures in the Richelieu Wing
- **Medieval Louvre foundations**

Temporary exhibitions and guided commentary beyond the 1-hour highlights route are not included.

## Mandatory meeting point instructions

**Do not go directly to the Louvre Pyramid entrance queue—your smartphone voucher will not be accepted at the museum turnstiles.** Instead, you must meet the **Extime Travel ambassador** at the **Arc du Carrousel (75001 Paris)**—specifically on the right-hand side of the arch when standing with the Louvre Pyramid behind you—at least **20 minutes before your scheduled departure time**. Save the meeting instructions offline on your phone in advance, as mobile data reception around the Carrousel courtyard can be congested.

## Price, ratings, and cancellation

When verified on 29 October 2026, tickets started at **€79.00**, with an aggregate rating of **3.9 out of 5 across 1,063 reviews**. Free cancellation and rescheduling are available up to **24 hours before your visit date**.
